rules.title: AWS EC2 metadata URL referenced
rules.message: Link-local metadata endpoint. In app code this often pairs with SSRF to steal cloud credentials.
rules.fix: Never fetch metadata from request-influenced URLs; use the instance role SDK path with IMDSv2.

rules.title: CORS Allow-Origin wildcard with credentials pattern
rules.message: Wildcard CORS is risky when combined with credentialed requests or sensitive APIs.
rules.fix: Reflect an allowlisted origin; never pair * with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
